title: 策略模式：结算怎样换一种算价办法？
style: Language-independent strategy design. Stable checkout workflow, independent interchangeable pricing strategies, common business contract and external selection. Show who owns changing algorithm detail and why the workflow delegates by contract. One original 100-yuan order, member90 then reset original100/campaign80. No source code, function/parameter teaching, language identifiers, cents, dense class diagrams, analogies, fake windows or decorative progress. Spoken chapter bridges before new details. Stable role and data identities; actual computation and returned payable shown in order.
sampleDataLabel: 示例订单 · 原价100元 · 优惠每次只选一种
userScope: Teach strategy design intent: isolate varying implementations of one task; use a shared meaningful contract; keep selection outside the workflow; delegate to the selected strategy; show replacement, independent maintenance boundaries and collaboration/selection costs. Concrete language implementation belongs to optional article appendix.
discussionQuestion: 换成另一种定价策略时，谁决定用哪一种，结算依赖的共同约定是什么？
